messages:
Elena: Packaging for onprem installer v1.4.7 is uploaded to staging bucket. Ready for cosign + KMS sign. Target cutover: today 22:00 UTC.
Olivia: I can take signer window at 21:00 UTC. Need the manifest list and the preferred alias name.
Elena: alias: rdx-private/installer:stable-priv. Manifest SHA: sha256:abcd1234ef56... (shorted). Full checksum in artifact metadata. I'll DM the full link.
deploy-bot: :package: packaging job #4821 queued, artifacts: gs://rdx-packages/private/1.4.7
Raj: Transport team — I'll schedule the escort to the airgap mirror at 02:00 local ops tomorrow. ETA ~ 3h transfer.
Mike_ops: Reminder: KMS key rotation scheduled earlier today. Confirming signing key used is key-prod-1 (not rotated). Olivia, can you confirm?
Olivia: Confirmed key-prod-1 used. I'll cosign with cosign v1.5. Use command: `cosign sign --key k8s://key-prod-1 gs://rdx-packages/...`
Elena: Rollback criteria: if canary fails >10% error or latency >2x baseline within first 10 minutes, we revert alias to v1.4.6 and pause transports. Agree?
James: Agree. Add extra: if checksum mismatch on mirror, abort and do not promote. We need an automated alias swap playbook.
Elena: I'll push a small playbook snippet to the ops repo and tag `onprem-cutover-playbook`.
Elena: playbook excerpt:
```
- verify: sha256sum artifact
- cosign verify
- push manifest to mirror (staged)
- wait 5 mins canary (traffic=5%)
- promote alias -> stable-priv if OK
```
Olivia: During signing I'll also generate a detached signature and upload to `gs://rdx-packages/signatures/1.4.7.sig`.
deploy-bot: :arrow_up: canary deploy started (job #4821). canary traffic 5% -> 10:15 UTC
sre-bot: :alert: canary alert: memory OOM on private-node-42 at 10:20 UTC (1/50), latency spike 1.6x
Raj: pausing transport. rolling back alias to v1.4.6 now.
Elena: Good catch — James, can you validate the root cause? If OOMs persist, we abort the cutover and open a hotfix branch.
James: Investigating — initial trace points to a config mismatch in container limits. Will submit patch later today.
Olivia: Cancelled remaining signer tasks. I'll hold signatures until we have a patched image.
Elena: Postmortem/next steps: 1) patch image and run local canary, 2) re-sign with key-prod-1, 3) re-run transport window and schedule a quieter cutover window (overnight). I'll create release note draft.
Olivia: ack.
Elena: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
